scope: Current Dots/Hermes quality audit; observations are coordinator findings, not independent acceptance

findings.title: False learned rule: finished cards allegedly reject comments and parent links
findings.detail: Native helpers accept a comment for done and return ready for a done parent in the isolated fixture; missing-id controls raise the exact errors. Mechanical correction card t_29903deb actually belongs to default, not fleet-ops. The old lesson attributed lookup errors to done status without evidence.
findings.status: Corrected only in active company procedural skill with skill_manage; no fleet-wide rollout.

findings.title: Final ZIP is byte-valid but not self-contained for named checks and documented rollback paths
findings.detail: Six named check/source artifacts and all 24 apply-backups paths are absent in the archive. Alternate before/ snapshots are present and byte-identical, so rollback bytes are NOT lost. Need explicit mapping or supplemental reproducibility archive; original ZIP remains immutable.

findings.title: Corrected receipt still self-identifies as the original defective JSON
findings.detail: Top artifact and artifacts.qa_candidate_json still name QA-CANDIDATE.json / this file, despite approved physical filename being QA-CANDIDATE-FIXED.json. Consumers using the explicit accepted filename are safe; self-link-following consumers may resolve to the preserved duplicate-key file. Need separate provenance/index, never silently change reviewer receipt.

findings.title: Final company acceptance is outside the canonical card thread; receipt fix is on default board
findings.detail: Both fleet-ops cards and the default-board mechanical fix are done. Exact native thread summaries do not contain the final company acceptance file/comment. Evidence exists on disk; registry trace is fragmented rather than missing. No proof that original unknown-id failures were caused by done.
findings.status: Unfixed; no retrospective lifecycle writes in this audit.

findings.title: Runtime behavioral benefit and full live loader eligibility are not tested
findings.detail: Loader probes use isolated copies; they establish discoverability/parsing, not each original profile disabled-state, collision-resolution, future compliance, stop/cancel effects or economics. These were explicitly excluded, not failed promised tests.

findings.title: LANE release-state is a pre-release snapshot, not current task truth
findings.detail: LANE still says held whereas actual cards are done; it declares audit binding, not a second registry. Preserve original and label snapshot time/supersession in a final index, do not use it as live state.

findings.title: Most byte duplicates are intentional preimages/backups, not live duplicate workflows
findings.detail: 192 local files; 6 byte-equal groups; 579689 redundant bytes. Repeated before/reference/root snapshots are safety/provenance. _company_readback.py and _qa_verify.py are non-final helpers (11733 bytes together). Neither broad deletion nor dedup of independently named rollback receipts is justified.

findings.title: One authoritative entry index and reproducible frozen file-list improve clarity
findings.detail: Separate final accepted files, historical negative/checkpoint receipts and reproduction tools in an index; preserve exact bytes/hashes. Build supplements from a canonical explicit list plus referenced-source closure. Keep the existing scoped hook (already conditional), no new schema, dispatcher, mandatory template or whole-skill sync. Effects on costs/behavior remain unmeasured.
